#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class Main {
public:
    void run() {
        int mod = 998244353;
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx;
            cin >> idx;
            v[idx] = 1;
        }
        
        vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if ((p & 1) == 1) {
                ans = multiply(ans, v, mod);
            }
            v = multiply(v, v, mod);
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
        }
        
        long long res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
        }
        cout << res << endl;
    }

    vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1)));
        
        vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
            long long x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            ar[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            ai[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(ar, ai, false);
        
        vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            long long x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(br, bi, false);
        
        vector<double> fr(n, 0.0), fi(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> gr(n, 0.0), gi(n, 0.0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            
            double ar1 = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai1 = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double ar2 = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5;
            double ai2 = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5;
            
            double br1 = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi1 = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double br2 = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5;
            double bi2 = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5;
            
            fr[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            fi[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
            gr[i] = ar1 * br2 - ai1 * bi2 + ar2 * br1 - ai2 * bi1;
            gi[i] = ar1 * bi2 + ai1 * br2 + ar2 * bi1 + ai2 * br1;
        }
        
        fft(fr, fi, true);
        fft(gr, gi, true);
        
        vector<int> res(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long a_val = llround(fr[i]);
            long long b_val = llround(gr[i]);
            long long c_val = llround(fi[i]);
            res[i] = (int)((a_val + ((b_val % mod) << 15) + ((c_val % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; (j ^= bit) < bit; bit >>= 1);
            if (i < j) {
                double t = re[i]; re[i] = re[j]; re[j] = t;
                t = im[i]; im[i] = im[j]; im[j] = t;
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            double ang = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
            double wlen_re = cos(ang);
            double wlen_im = sin(ang);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                double w_re = 1.0;
                double w_im = 0.0;
                for (int j = 0; j < len / 2; j++) {
                    double u_re = re[i + j];
                    double u_im = im[i + j];
                    double v_re = re[i + j + len/2] * w_re - im[i + j + len/2] * w_im;
                    double v_im = re[i + j + len/2] * w_im + im[i + j + len/2] * w_re;
                    
                    re[i + j] = u_re + v_re;
                    im[i + j] = u_im + v_im;
                    re[i + j + len/2] = u_re - v_re;
                    im[i + j + len/2] = u_im - v_im;
                    
                    double tmp = w_re * wlen_re - w_im * wlen_im;
                    w_im = w_re * wlen_im + w_im * wlen_re;
                    w_re = tmp;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.run();
    return 0;
}
